text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Our next target is the Sapporo Kinen— and 
that was the beginning of a modest little 
pleasure.

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
"Butter ice cream sandwich... And the 
crepe with the long-tailed tit on top is 
so adorbs♪"

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Hey, hey, I heard there are tons of yummy 
restaurants in front of Sapporo Station. I 
wanna go, I wanna go~!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Fusaichi Pandora scrolled through social 
media posts, looking forward to a short 
trip between her overseas races.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
There seem to be many posts of interest, 
but—
choice_data_list: I can go to all of them.

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: Seriously!?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
If we make good use of the time before 
arriving at the hotel, we might be able to 
see everything.
choice_data_list: And nearby sightseeing spots... found one!

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
"The zoo! Ah, so cuuute~~♡ The polar bear 
is swimming~~♡"

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Ah, I know this statue! Seriously, it's 
here? Huh...!
choice_data_list:
It might be fun to take a commemorative 
photo, too.

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Strike the same pose as the statue? Ahaha, 
that's hilarious!

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Eat good food by the station, see lots of 
cute animals at the zoo, and strike the 
same pose as the statues?

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: Aha, that sounds like so much fun♡
choice_data_list: Alright, I'll set up a schedule for us.

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: Thanksies~♡

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: Hmm hum hum~♪ Hok-kai-do~☆ Hok-kai-do~☆

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
All right, let's do our best packing. 
After all, it's Hokkaido we're talking 
about~!

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Thiiis, and thiiis... Oh, lemme take this 
too~.

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
I'd totally hate for my mood to plummet on 
a trip. I wanna stay cute, after all~

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: Essentials, essentials☆

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Phew... Is this enough? I'm so glad I 
brought my biggest suitcase!

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: Is it too big, maybe?

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
(Wait, we're gonna hang out before heading 
to the hotel, right? Which means... I 
gotta carry this around?)

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Eeeh~~!? No way!? Doesn't that mean we 
can't hang out? What a draaag!

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Buuut, there's nothing I can cut down 
onnn...

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: ...Hm? It's from Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"'I put together a schedule for our trip 
to Sapporo. How does this look? I can't 
wait!'"

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Ugh...! Amazing, it really is with all the 
toppings...!
choice_data_list:
"Ah! Let's wear shoes that are easy to 
walk in."

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
"...Spamming messages like that. She's 
seriously hyped up, huh..."

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
"...Looks like they packed it with tons of 
places to go, all super hyped up..."

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: Urrrghhh...!

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: ...Ghh!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Stare... rustle rustle)

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: A facial steamer...

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
...I-I'll just make do with a face mask 
this time!

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
A body pillow... Uuu~~, stay behind and 
watch the house!

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Hair straightener... definitely need this! 
Nail polish set... only the colors I'll 
use...

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text: Oh? Pandora, organizing luggage?!

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Ngh! But I really wanna bring all of 
them~!

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Buuut... that's too haaard... We gotta 
make it as compact as possible, otherwise 
it's no goood...

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
"I see... In that case, how about some 
packing tips for your luggage?"

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: !!! Tell meeeee--!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And on the day of our departure for 
Hokkaido— I was shocked when I saw 
Fusaichi Pandora's luggage.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Compared to her usual luggage, this is 
overwhelmingly meager...!

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: Ehe... Ehehe.

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: It's fine♡ Ehehehehe~~.

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Come on, let's go, Trainer! Hokkaido is 
waiting for us~!

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: Let's have tons of fun, okay? ♡

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Seriously, I worked so hard on this, you 
know? Selecting the athletes was crazy 
tough!

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Yup! Reluctantly, though! I really didn't 
wanna leave you behind to look after the 
house, you know?

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Well, since we worked so hard... Let's 
have a blast over there♡
